tasks.label: Flash Pico - Stage 10
tasks.detail: Build and verified firmware-only flash; preserves CP/M disks and ENV.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoFlashSafety}" != "Proceed" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DPICO_BOARD=pico2_w && cmake --build build --target z80_stage10_websocket_terminal -j && python scripts/pico_flash.py firmware build/src/stage10_websocket_terminal/z80_stage10_websocket_terminal.uf2 --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - All disks (A-D)
tasks.detail: Replace all four disks from build/cpm-stage09-loader; no backups. Firmware, boot and ENV are preserved.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive A=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_a_cpm63k-z80.img --drive B=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_b_bdsc.img --drive C=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_c_escape.img --drive D=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_d_blank.img --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive A
tasks.detail: Replace A with the board-native CP/M system disk; installed boot compatibility is checked. No backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive A=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_a_cpm63k-z80.img --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive B
tasks.detail: Replace only B with drive_b_bdsc.img (BDS C); no backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive B=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_b_bdsc.img --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive C
tasks.detail: Replace only C with drive_c_escape.img (Escape); no backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive C=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_c_escape.img --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive D
tasks.detail: Replace only D with drive_d_blank.img (blank disk); no backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive D=build/cpm-stage09-loader/drive_d_blank.img --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Prepare interactive CP/M emulator
tasks.command: cmake -S src/cpm/z80_debug_host -B build/cpm/z80_debug_host -DZ80_DEBUG_HOST_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF && cmake --build build/cpm/z80_debug_host && cmake -S src/cpm/dcc_io_adapter -B build/cpm/dcc_io_adapter -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF && cmake --build build/cpm/dcc_io_adapter && python3 src/cpm/build_images.py --assembler z80asm --output-dir build/cpm

inputs.description: Selected disks will be overwritten with no backups. Confirm external +5 V is applied before USB and CP/M work is saved.
Confirm external +5 V is applied before USB and CP/M work is saved before flashing Stage 10.
